name: Job Sarkari Hub
description: Comprehensive Indian Government Job Portal with real-time automatic synchronization for Rajasthan State Recruitment Portal (https://www.recruitment.rajasthan.gov.in/), SBI Careers (https://sbi.bank.in/web/careers/current-openings), IBPS (https://www.ibps.in/), RRB (https://www.rrbapply.gov.in/), UPSC (https://www.upsc.gov.in/), and SSC (https://ssc.gov.in/) notifications, vacancies, admit cards, results, answer keys, and mock tests.
